subject.title: Renderer placeholder leak: `(see attached image)`, `Image reply`, `Audio reply`, `Media reply` leak to human-visible Telegram reply under specific content-classification paths

question: Should repair work begin from the reported source hypothesis, or require a current-main trace showing the placeholder in the Telegram outbound payload first?
rationale: The released-version observation is credible, but current source separates WebChat display, transcript, prompt, and Telegram delivery representations; choosing a repair boundary without the missing trace could damage legitimate context behavior.

options.title: Require boundary capture
options.body: Obtain a current-main Telegram reproduction that records the normalized reply payload and Bot API send/edit input before assigning a code fix.

options.title: Sponsor exploratory repair
options.body: Authorize an owner-led investigation and patch that traces all media-only reply representations while preserving existing prompt and transcript anchors.

recommendation.title: Require boundary capture
recommendation.body: Obtain a current-main Telegram reproduction that records the normalized reply payload and Bot API send/edit input before assigning a code fix.

likelyOwner.reason: Their recent merged work and live proof cover the closest Telegram rendering boundary among the available history signals.
